title: Spend your extra hour well
headline: Spend your extra hour well
caption:
What will you do with your extra hour? 🕰️

The clocks go back tonight, so tomorrow brings an extra hour in bed, or an extra hour just for you.

From next week the evenings get darker earlier. A booked-in class gives your week a calm, warm hour of Pilates in Clitheroe to look forward to, right here on York Street.

Reformer, Mat and Stretch: every level is welcome, and no experience is needed.

Take a quiet minute this weekend to plan next week's classes through the link in our bio.

📍 POWR Studio, 9 York Street, Clitheroe
